title: Garden Party
one_paragraph_synopsis: In "Garden Party," Andy hosts a garden party at Dunder Mifflin to impress his parents and Robert California, despite a defaced billboard promoting him. Dwight attempts to promote Schrute Farms as a high-end event venue, while various characters engage in toasts, speeches, and playful interactions. The episode features family introductions, including Andy's younger brother Walter Jr., and culminates in a father-son duet. Throughout, there are humorous and awkward moments, with some uncertainties about the party's ultimate success and the significance of Dwight's garden party book and ice sculpture.
